Infrared Sauna Carbon Heaters

Hello! Our main goal is to provide your best quality infrared sauna parts. Just complete the form and our specialist would contact you as soon as possible!

Some reasons to choose us!

  • Is your infrared sauna business suffering from lack of quality equipment?
  • Have the companies that supply you the equipment gone out of business?

We’re the leading infrared sauna parts suppliers that have been the backbone for many infrared saunas across the country. We are the leading supplier because we’ve been in business since 2001 and we’re not about to leave.

Many suppliers of infrared sauna parts last about 4 – 5 years before they close down or go belly up. Due to this, many of their clients aren’t able to maintain the equipment and/or broken ones replaced. As a business owner, it can be frustrating when you’re not able to find things that you need to make sure your business runs smoothly.

Thank God for InfraredSaunaParts because if it weren’t for them, I have to close up shop and my sauna is all I have. They’re able to supply me with anything and everything that I need to get my sauna back on track!”

Zoe, Austin, Texas

At InfraredSaunaParts, we make sure we’re able to cater to our clients’ every need. Whether it’s sauna accessories, or hardware, or electrical appliances. Our facility is more than 30,000 sq ft and we make sure we have all the resources a client may need.

Many of our clients come to us for our carbon heaters, which comes in 9 different selections to suit their sauna needs. Carbon heaters use thin carbon plates to evenly distribute heat in a given space. For a sauna, carbon heaters are essentials and this is why we make certain that our carbon heaters are of the highest grade and safety regulations certified.

Make the smart decision today by contacting us to find out how we can help your business grow and thrive. Many infrared saunas have called it quits, but don’t let yours be one of them.
